e.title: CLM（美国理赔与诉讼管理联盟）：五类会员、理赔学院与诉讼管理研究院
e.title_en: CLM (Claims and Litigation Management Alliance): five membership classes, a Claims College and a Litigation Management Institute
e.title_hk: CLM（美國理賠與訴訟管理聯盟）：五類會員、理賠學院與訴訟管理研究院
e.summary: 美国理赔与诉讼管理跨行业专业组织：设保险专业、外部律师、服务商、企业与 Fellows 五类会员，并开办理赔学院、诉讼管理研究院与保险责任训练营，另设行业资源目录、调解仲裁名录与地方分会
e.summary_en: A US cross-industry professional body for claims and litigation management: it has five membership classes (insurance professional, outside counsel, service provider, corporate and fellows), runs a Claims College, a Litigation Management Institute and an Insurance Coverage Bootcamp, and offers an industry resource directory, a mediators/arbitrators listing and local chapters
e.summary_hk: 美國理賠與訴訟管理跨行業專業組織：設保險專業、外部律師、服務商、企業與 Fellows 五類會員，並開辦理賠學院、訴訟管理研究院與保險責任訓練營，另設行業資源目錄、調解仲裁名錄與地方分會
e.body:
**CLM（Claims and Litigation Management Alliance，美国理赔与诉讼管理联盟）** 是**美国理赔与诉讼管理领域的跨行业专业组织**（站点标题实测 **「Claims and Litigation Management Alliance」**）。本条目补的是**「理赔作为跨行业专业共同体」这一形态**——**与同轮 [[cila]]（个人资格认证）和 [[fuedi]]（欧洲区域伞状）不同，CLM 补的是「理赔与诉讼管理这条线上多方（保险公司、外部律师、服务商、企业）共同的专业组织与教育体系」**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：站点首页 **66.6KB，标题「Claims and Litigation Management Alliance」**；**公开可见页面实测含** **`/IndustryResourceDirectory`（60.8KB）**、**`/resourceecourses`**、**`/event/calendar`**、**`/InPersonEvents`**、**`/VirtualEvents`**、**`/Register/Fellow`**。⭐ **⚠️ 一个必须说明的技术事实**：**该站导航由 JavaScript 拼装**（**实测 href 中含 `+ item.URL +` 这类模板片段**），**故导航链接无法从 href 抽取——本词条的内容结构是从页面正文文字读出的**。**正文逐字实测揭示的结构**：⭐ **会员类型** 共五类——**Insurance Professional（保险专业）**、**Outside Counsel（外部律师）**、**Service Provider（服务商）**、**Corporate（企业）**、**Fellows**；⭐ **资源** 含 **CLM Tracker**、**Designations（专业称号）**、**Litigation Management Task Force（诉讼管理工作组）**、**E-Courses（线上课程）**、**Magazines（杂志）**、**Sponsorship Opportunities**、⭐ **Dispute Resolution（争议解决）**、⭐ **Job Search（职位搜索）**；**News** 含 **Professional of the Year**、UCC；⭐ **活动与教育项目** 实测含 **2026 Claims College（理赔学院）**、**2026 Construction Conference**、**Insurance Coverage Bootcamp（保险责任训练营）**、**2026 Litigation Management Symposium**、⭐ **2026 Litigation Management Institute（诉讼管理研究院）**；⭐ **「Our network」分组** 实测含 **Member Directory（会员名录）**、**Advisory Board**、⭐ **Young Professionals Advisory Board（青年专业者顾问委员会）**、**Fellows**、**Members**、⭐ **Mediators / Arbitrators（调解员/仲裁员）**；**Communities** 下含 ⭐ **Local Chapters（地方分会）**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「理赔作为一门专业」的组织与教育体系**——**池内理赔侧此前全是技术工具**，**而 CLM 展示的是一条完整路径：五类会员 → 专业称号（Designations）→ 线上课程 → 理赔学院/诉讼管理研究院 → 地方分会**；**对考虑进入理赔、诉讼管理或保险责任（coverage）方向的 RIAA 毕业生，这是一个美国侧的完整专业发展地图**（**与同轮 [[cila]] 的英国侧形成「英/美」对照**）。**② ⭐ 「五类会员」的设计值得单独注意**——**保险专业、外部律师、服务商、企业、Fellows**：**理赔实务天然是多方协作（理赔员 + 律师 + 定损/服务商 + 企业风险经理）**，**故该组织把「跨角色」写进会员结构**；**这与池内 [[three-lines-of-defense]]（公司内部治理分工）属不同层面的「协作结构」**。**③ ⭐ 「保险责任训练营（Insurance Coverage Bootcamp）」与「理赔学院」是两种不同性质的教育**——**前者针对「什么在保单责任范围内」这一法律判断，后者针对理赔作业**；**对做保单条款与理赔争议的学生，「coverage」是一条独立的知识线**（**可与池内 [[insurance-qa-en]]、[[policy-explainer-ai]]、[[clausegraph]]、[[clauseguard]] 的条款/责任侧并读**）。**④ 「调解员/仲裁员名录」与「争议解决」把理赔延伸到纠纷解决**——**与同轮 [[mib]] 的「行业补偿机制」和 [[hk-icb]]、[[fos-uk]] 的「消费者争议裁决」构成理赔后的三条不同路径**（**内部争议解决 / 行业仲裁 / 监管申诉**）。**⑤ 「青年专业者顾问委员会」是少见的设计**——**行业组织为青年从业者设专门的顾问委员会**（**对本站读者（学生/新入行）直接相关**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与六个公开页面的存在、标题（部分无标题）、页面体量、以及正文逐字实测的会员类型、资源、活动与网络分组**，**但未打开任何课程、杂志、称号说明、资源目录内容、会员名录或活动详情**，因此**不能转述任何课程内容、称号要求、会员条件、费用或活动安排**；**② ⭐ 导航为 JS 拼装（href 中实测含 `+ item.URL +`），故本词条的结构信息全部来自正文文字而非链接抽取**——**这一点已在词条内明确写出，以便后续维护者理解为何无法逐条给出 URL**；**③ `Member Directory`、`Fellows`、`Mediators / Arbitrators` 等条目很可能需要登录**（**首页实测有 `JOIN/LOGIN` 与 `/account/login`**）——**故本词条不主张这些名录可公开检索**；**④ ⭐ 我猜测的 `/membership` 路径实测 404**——**真实入口为 `/Register/Fellow` 与站内 JS 导航**；**⑤ `/IndustryResourceDirectory` 实测无页面标题（NO-TITLE）**，**其内容结构未核实**；**⑥ 「Fellows」是会员类型还是称号层级本次未核实**（**词条内按页面实测的并列关系列出，未作层级判断**）；**⑦ 该组织的规模、成立年份与治理结构本次未核实**；**⑧** 本词条**不主张** CLM 提供精算工具、数据或模型**。**核实说明**：首页（66.6KB）与公开页 `/IndustryResourceDirectory`（60.8KB）等均经**缓冲区安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 实测，**结构信息由正文文字逐字读取**（因导航为 JS 拼装）；`/membership` 实测 404；**未打开课程、杂志、称号说明、资源目录内容、会员名录或活动详情**。
e.body_en:
**CLM (the Claims and Litigation Management Alliance)** is **a US cross-industry professional body for claims and litigation management** (measured site title **"Claims and Litigation Management Alliance"**). This entry adds the **"claims as a cross-industry professional community"** form — **unlike [[cila]] (individual qualification) and [[fuedi]] (a European regional umbrella) in the same round, CLM adds the professional body and education system shared along the claims and litigation management line by insurers, outside counsel, service providers and corporates**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage is **66.6KB with the measured title "Claims and Litigation Management Alliance"**; **measured publicly visible pages include `/IndustryResourceDirectory` (60.8KB)**, **`/resourceecourses`**, **`/event/calendar`**, **`/InPersonEvents`**, **`/VirtualEvents`** and **`/Register/Fellow`**. ⭐ **⚠️ A technical fact that must be stated**: **this site’s navigation is assembled by JavaScript** (**measured hrefs contain template fragments such as `+ item.URL +`**), **so navigation links cannot be extracted from hrefs — the structural information in this entry was read from the page body text**. **Structure read verbatim from the body**: ⭐ **five membership classes** — **Insurance Professional**, **Outside Counsel**, **Service Provider**, **Corporate** and **Fellows**; ⭐ **resources** — **CLM Tracker**, **Designations**, **Litigation Management Task Force**, **E-Courses**, **Magazines**, **Sponsorship Opportunities**, ⭐ **Dispute Resolution** and ⭐ **Job Search**; **News** covers **Professional of the Year** and UCC; ⭐ **measured events and education programmes** include **2026 Claims College**, **2026 Construction Conference**, **Insurance Coverage Bootcamp**, **2026 Litigation Management Symposium** and ⭐ **2026 Litigation Management Institute**; ⭐ the **"Our network"** grouping measurably includes **Member Directory**, **Advisory Board**, ⭐ **Young Professionals Advisory Board**, **Fellows**, **Members** and ⭐ **Mediators / Arbitrators**; **Communities** includes ⭐ **Local Chapters**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the organisation and education system of claims as a profession** — **the corpus’s claims side previously held only technical tools**, **whereas CLM sets out a complete path: five membership classes → designations → e-courses → a Claims College and Litigation Management Institute → local chapters**; **for RIAA graduates considering claims, litigation management or coverage work, this is a complete US-side professional development map** (**contrasting with the UK side in [[cila]]**). **② ⭐ The five membership classes deserve separate note** — **insurance professional, outside counsel, service provider, corporate and fellows**: **claims practice is inherently multi-party (adjuster plus lawyer plus loss assessor or provider plus corporate risk manager)**, **so the body writes cross-role participation into its membership structure**; **a different kind of "collaboration structure" from the internal-governance division in [[three-lines-of-defense]]**. **③ ⭐ The "Insurance Coverage Bootcamp" and the "Claims College" are two different kinds of education** — **the former addresses the legal judgement of what falls within policy coverage, the latter claims operations**; **for students working on policy wording and claims disputes, "coverage" is an independent knowledge line** (readable with the wording and coverage items [[insurance-qa-en]], [[policy-explainer-ai]], [[clausegraph]] and [[clauseguard]]). **④ The mediators/arbitrators listing and Dispute Resolution extend claims into dispute resolution** — **together with [[mib]]’s industry compensation mechanism and the consumer dispute adjudication of [[hk-icb]] and [[fos-uk]], they mark three different post-claim paths** (**internal dispute resolution / industry arbitration / regulatory complaint**). **⑤ A "Young Professionals Advisory Board" is an uncommon design** — **a trade body creating a dedicated advisory board for early-career practitioners** (**directly relevant to this wiki’s student and new-entrant readers**).

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the homepage and six public pages’ existence, titles (some with none), page sizes, and the membership classes, resources, events and network groupings read verbatim from the body**, **but opened no course, magazine, designation description, resource-directory content, member listing or event detail**, so **no course content, designation requirement, membership condition, fee or event schedule can be restated**; **② ⭐ the navigation is JavaScript-assembled (measured hrefs contain `+ item.URL +`), so all structural information here comes from body text rather than link extraction** — **stated explicitly in the entry so future maintainers understand why per-item URLs cannot be given**; **③ items such as Member Directory, Fellows and Mediators / Arbitrators are likely login-gated** (**the homepage measurably carries `JOIN/LOGIN` and `/account/login`**) — **so this entry does not claim these listings are publicly searchable**; **④ ⭐ the path I guessed, `/membership`, measured 404** — **the real entry points are `/Register/Fellow` and the in-site JS navigation**; **⑤ `/IndustryResourceDirectory` measurably has no page title (NO-TITLE)**, **and its content structure was not verified**; **⑥ whether "Fellows" is a membership class or a designation tier was not verified** (**the entry lists it as the page measurably presents it, making no hierarchy claim**); **⑦ the organisation’s size, founding year and governance were not verified**; **⑧** this entry **does not claim CLM provides actuarial tools, data or models**. **Verification note**: the homepage (66.6KB) and public pages such as `/IndustryResourceDirectory` (60.8KB) were measured at HTTP 200 using the **buffer-safe probe tool `discovery/probe-urls.sh`**, with **structure read verbatim from body text** (because the navigation is JavaScript-assembled); `/membership` measured 404; **no course, magazine, designation description, resource-directory content, member listing or event detail was opened**.
e.body_hk:
**CLM（Claims and Litigation Management Alliance，美國理賠與訴訟管理聯盟）** 是**美國理賠與訴訟管理領域的跨行業專業組織**。本條目補的是**「理賠作為跨行業專業共同體」這一形態**——**與同輪 [[cila]]（個人資格）和 [[fuedi]]（歐洲區域傘狀）不同，CLM 補的是「保險公司、外部律師、服務商、企業多方共同參與的專業組織與教育體系」**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁 **66.6KB**；**公開頁面實測含 `/IndustryResourceDirectory`（60.8KB）／`/resourceecourses`／`/event/calendar`／`/InPersonEvents`／`/VirtualEvents`／`/Register/Fellow`**。⭐ **⚠️ 必須說明的技術事實**：**該站導航由 JavaScript 拼裝**（**實測 href 中含 `+ item.URL +` 這類模板片段**），**故導航連結無法從 href 抽取——本詞條的結構信息是從頁面正文文字讀出的**。**正文逐字實測**：⭐ **會員類型五類**——**Insurance Professional／Outside Counsel／Service Provider／Corporate／Fellows**；⭐ **資源** 含 **CLM Tracker／Designations／Litigation Management Task Force／E-Courses／Magazines／Sponsorship Opportunities／⭐Dispute Resolution／⭐Job Search**；⭐ **活動與教育** 含 **2026 Claims College（理賠學院）／2026 Construction Conference／Insurance Coverage Bootcamp（保險責任訓練營）／2026 Litigation Management Symposium／⭐2026 Litigation Management Institute（訴訟管理研究院）**；⭐ **「Our network」** 含 **Member Directory／Advisory Board／⭐Young Professionals Advisory Board／Fellows／Members／⭐Mediators-Arbitrators**；**Communities** 含 ⭐ **Local Chapters**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「理賠作為一門專業」的組織與教育體系**——**池內理賠側此前全是技術工具**，**而 CLM 展示完整路徑：五類會員 → 專業稱號 → 線上課程 → 理賠學院／訴訟管理研究院 → 地方分會**（**與同輪 [[cila]] 的英國側形成「英／美」對照**）。**② ⭐ 「五類會員」值得單獨注意**——**理賠實務天然是多方協作，故該組織把「跨角色」寫進會員結構**。**③ ⭐ 「保險責任訓練營」與「理賠學院」是兩種不同性質的教育**——**前者針對「什麼在保單責任範圍內」這一法律判斷，後者針對理賠作業**（可與 [[insurance-qa-en]]、[[policy-explainer-ai]]、[[clausegraph]]、[[clauseguard]] 並讀）。**④ 「調解員/仲裁員名錄」與「爭議解決」把理賠延伸到糾紛解決**——**與同輪 [[mib]] 及 [[hk-icb]]、[[fos-uk]] 構成理賠後的三條不同路徑**（**內部爭議解決／行業仲裁／監管申訴**）。**⑤ 「青年專業者顧問委員會」是少見設計**——**對本站讀者直接相關**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與六個公開頁面的存在、標題（部分無標題）、體量、正文逐字實測的會員類型、資源、活動與網絡分組**，**但未打開任何課程、雜誌、稱號說明、資源目錄內容、會員名錄或活動詳情**，故**不能轉述任何課程內容、稱號要求、會員條件、費用或活動安排**；**② ⭐ 導航為 JS 拼裝，故本詞條結構信息全部來自正文文字而非連結抽取**——**已在詞條內明確寫出**；**③ Member Directory／Fellows／Mediators-Arbitrators 等很可能需要登入**（**首頁實測有 `JOIN/LOGIN` 與 `/account/login`**）——**故不主張可公開檢索**；**④ ⭐ 我猜測的 `/membership` 實測 404**；**⑤ `/IndustryResourceDirectory` 實測無頁面標題（NO-TITLE）**，**內容結構未核實**；**⑥ 「Fellows」是會員類型還是稱號層級未核實**；**⑦ 規模、成立年份與治理結構未核實**；**⑧** 本詞條**不主張** CLM 提供精算工具、數據或模型**。**核實說明**：首頁與公開頁均經**緩衝區安全探活工具 `discovery/probe-urls.sh`** HTTP 200 實測，**結構信息由正文文字逐字讀取**；`/membership` 實測 404；**未打開課程、雜誌、稱號說明、資源目錄內容、會員名錄或活動詳情**。
